data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Selene is the goddess of the moon. Her name is derived from the Greek word for moon, selene. She was often depicted in art as a woman riding a chariot pulled by horses. The name Selle carries the meaning “Moon Goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Selle usually hope their child will grow to embody moon goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Sella

data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian faith, the name Selle could be seen as a reflection of the divine and creative powers of God.
